check.description: Text and images of text meet a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 (3:1 for large text >=18pt or >=14pt bold).

sources.internal_policy_ref: HSBC digital accessibility framework — WCAG 2.2 AA minimum, governed by Group Digital Experience and Accessibility (mandatory on all HSBC digital projects). GTB brand: grey-6 (#767676) is the minimum text colour on white (~4.48:1).

verified_by.mechanism: Every text/icon token in the store is contrast-checked at 4.5:1 against its worst-case dark surface (gates the build); joined down to component granularity via the token blast-radius reverse index.
verified_by.coverage: 19/19 applies_to components have a bound audited token

external_automatable_refs.description: Ensure the contrast between foreground and background colors meets WCAG 2 AA minimum contrast ratio thresholds
